newsitem.title: PERU: Lima bolsa closes weaker amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Lima bolsa closes weaker amid profit-taking.

text.p: Lima shares slipped overall Thursday amid profit-taking despite a surge by blue-chip miner Buenaventura, brokers said.
They predicted further profit-taking for Friday's session.
"It has been a session of adjustments, especially in mining shares that have been rising for a month and a half," said Mariana Prado, of MGS brokerage.
Miners Atacocha and Morococha suffered from profit-taking after recent bull runs, the former off 3.36 percent top 2.30 soles and the latter falling 4.06 percent to 6.62 soles.
Another miner, Minsur, also fell back 0.45 percent to 11.15 soles.
"The miners have corrected themselves because they rose strongly in recent weeks, encouraged by the rises in the price of zinc and the sector's strong expectations," said another broker.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru gained 0.15 percent to 6.57 soles.
